newsitem.title: USA: US administration backs cigarette tax -- official.
newsitem.headline: US administration backs cigarette tax -- official.

text.p: The Clinton administration supports the idea of raising additional revenues through an increased cigarette tax, an administration official said Friday.

The Senate Finance Committee passed tax legislation late Thursday that included a cigarette tax increase of 20 cents per pack in addition to the current 24-cent tax. The House tax bill does not include a cigarette tax increase.
"We support the idea of raising additional revenue by increasing the cigarette tax, we do not believe that it's inconsistent with the bipartisan budget agreement," the official said.

"But we think that the additional revenues that would be raised through higher cigarette taxes should be used exclusively for children and health, and not for the benefit of corporate activities," the official said.
